limitations: Actual native3.0 WASM rendering/callback checks do not establish target2.12.4 physical-radio performance.

Current-telemetry cases use a development-only staged widget driver and private-VM API fixtures; production app/modules remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Separate clean-widget cases exercise the unmodified productionwidget.
Synthetic telemetry/MSP does not verify RF cadence, connectedquad sensors, physicalswitchhardware or FC settingwrites.
Accepted sustained warm uses automatic garbage collection only; no forced collection is performed.
Native3.0 loadScript environment argument loses its table; the developmentdriver snapshots nativeAPIs then installs fixturewrappers only in its isolatedVM. No API hook/budget overrides.
